title: Schedule list is empty after logging into Cloud
description: The Schedule List appears empty upon login to the Cloud environment, despite the presence of data.
steps: Enter valid email and password in the login fields.
Tap the 'GO TO MY SITES' button.
Tap the 'Lights' button in the top right corner.
actual: The screen displays '+ CREATE SCHEDULE' and is otherwise blank, indicating an empty schedule list.
expected: The Schedule List should display existing schedules after logging into the Cloud environment.
